item.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 26/0553Z
item.description: POLO REMAINS AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS CATEGORY 5 HURRICANE. ...EXPECTED TO MAKE LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR ON MONDAY AS A POWERFUL HURRICANE...
